title: Ed25519 — security analysis
description: Ed25519 is a digital signature scheme using the Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm over Curve25519. Designed by Daniel J. Bernstein and colleagues and published in 2011, it produces compact 64-byte signatures with fast, side-channel-resistant implementations. Designed by Daniel J.
